case_title.quote: RAJIB RANJAN & ORS. V. R. VIJAYKUMAR
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.correct_value: 6 accused in total: four appellants (accused Nos. 3-6) plus accused No.1 (successful bidder) and No.2 (Chief Engineer, JSEB)
number_of_accused.quote: arrayed as accused Nos.3, 4, 5 and 6; accused No.1 (Successful Bidder) & accused No. 2
number_of_accused.reason: Count of 4 covers only the appellants; the complaint also named accused Nos. 1 and 2.

accused_gender.reason: Gender of accused is not stated in the judgment.

accused_age.reason: Age of accused is not stated.

accused_occupation.quote: the appellants being public servants and Gazetted officers of the State Government of Chhattisgarh
accused_occupation.reason: Judgment states appellants are public servants.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Complainant's gender is not stated; he is a company officer, not an individual victim described.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: No personal relationship between accused and complainant is stated; they were competing bidder-side parties.

offence_category.correct_value: Forgery, cheating, criminal conspiracy and defamation (IPC ss.120B, 468, 420, 500)
offence_category.reason: Charged offences are forgery, cheating, conspiracy and defamation; breach of trust is only mentioned as an element.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 120-B, 468, 420 and 500 of the Indian Penal Code
statutory_provisions.reason: Matches the IPC sections in the complaint.

evidence_type.quote: Performance Report Cum Certificate, which was issued by accused No.2
evidence_type.reason: Judgment does not characterise evidence as circumstantial; it refers to documents and reports.

confession.reason: No confession is mentioned in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: The learned Judicial Magistrate took cognizance of the said complaint and summoned the appellants.
trial_court_outcome.reason: Judgment confirms cognizance was taken and summons issued.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: High Court dismissed the appellants' petitions under s.482 and refused to quash the proceedings
high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court ... has not found any merit ... and, consequently, dismissed their petitions.
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court did act: it dismissed the quashing petitions, so 'Not applicable' is wrong.

final_outcome.correct_value: Appeals allowed; High Court order set aside; cognizance and summoning orders set aside; complaint dismissed
final_outcome.quote: these appeals are allowed. Order of the High Court is set aside ... resulting into the dismissal of the said complaint.
final_outcome.reason: No acquittal occurred; the complaint itself was dismissed through quashing.

offence_finally_established.reason: No offence was established; the complaint was quashed.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is imposed in this case; the Rs.25,000 costs relate to the earlier writ petition.

neutral_facts.correct_value: A neutral summary of the tender, rejection, civil suit, writ petition, SLP and criminal complaint, without stating the Supreme Court's outcome
neutral_facts.quote: the Supreme Court allowed the appeal and set aside the High Court's order, finding the criminal complaint was a misuse of the process of law
neutral_facts.reason: Facts reveal the court outcome, which the neutral_facts field must not do. Other facts are broadly accurate.

attempt_completion.quote: fabrication of the Certificate-cum-Report dated 28.12.2004 which was used against him in rejecting his tender
attempt_completion.reason: Alleged certificate was created and used, supporting a completed-offence allegation.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Four counts charged (IPC ss.120B, 468, 420, 500); none upheld; complaint quashed
number_of_offences.reason: Four counts were charged, but none were upheld; the complaint was dismissed.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Alleged wrongful loss to complainant's company by losing its chance to get the Boiler Plant Units contract at Korba (as alleged, not found)
financial_property_loss.quote: caused a wrongful loss to the complainant's company by robbing its due chance to get a contract for the Boiler Plant Units at Korba
financial_property_loss.reason: This is only an allegation in the complaint, not a finding of loss.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Complaint alleged a conspiracy and a plan to fabricate the certificate dated 28.12.2004; Court found the fabrication allegation an afterthought
premeditation_planning.quote: they planned to fabricate the said certificate dated 28.12.2004
premeditation_planning.reason: Value gives the court's afterthought finding, not the alleged planning, which is what the field asks for.

motive.quote: attempt is made by the respondent to convert a case with civil nature into criminal prosecution
motive.reason: Court identifies this as the respondent's motive.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the report of the technical experts went against the respondent as it opined that the respondent was not technically suitable
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court relied on JSEB and technical reports as supporting the tender rejection.

witness_credibility.quote: the evidence regarding the allegations made in the complaint have to be recorded and gone into by the trial court
witness_credibility.reason: No witness credibility assessment is made; the High Court said evidence is yet to be recorded.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct of the accused is described as such; the respondent's civil and writ proceedings are not characterised as such.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence/certificate date: 28.12.2004; Trial judgment: not stated; High Court decision: 03.06.2009; Supreme Court decision: 14.10.2014
trial_duration.quote: From the Judgment & Order dated 03.06.2009 of the High Court of Madras
trial_duration.reason: High Court (03.06.2009) and Supreme Court (14.10.2014) decision dates are stated; the certificate date is also given.

legal_representation.quote: Rahul Srivastava, Ram Swarup Sharma for the Appellants. R. Vijaykumar (Respondent-in-person).
legal_representation.reason: Appellant counsel matches; no State counsel is recorded.

investigation_status.correct_value: No charge sheet; police refused to register the complaint and a private complaint was filed before the Magistrate
investigation_status.quote: The police authorities refused to register the same on the ground that it is a civil dispute.
investigation_status.reason: No charge sheet is mentioned; the complaint was filed directly before the Magistrate.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is found by the court.

appeal_history.quote: The High Court ... dismissed their petitions.
appeal_history.reason: High Court dismissal and Supreme Court allowance match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Respondent (complainant) argued the appellants conspired and fabricated the certificate, and that s.197 sanction was not needed as the offences were conspiracy, cheating and defamation
prosecution_argument.quote: the question of obtaining sanction under Section 197 Cr.P.C. will not arise in so far as the present complaint is concerned
prosecution_argument.reason: Value assigns the appellants' sanction and abuse-of-process arguments to the prosecution, reversing the roles.

defence_argument.correct_value: Appellants argued s.197 sanction was required, the complaint was an afterthought after failed civil suit, complainant lacked locus standi, and the acts were official duties
defence_argument.quote: the complaint has been lodged as an afterthought, having failed in the civil suit
defence_argument.reason: Afterthought, locus standi and official duties are covered, but the sanction argument is omitted and 'fabricated' is overstated.

legal_principle_applied.correct_value: Sanction under s.197 applies only if the act has reasonable connection with official duty (Budhikota test); fabrication and conspiracy are not official duty; s.482 quashing for abuse of process (Bhajan Lal categories 6 and 7)
legal_principle_applied.quote: reasonable connection with discharge of his duty then it must be held to be official
legal_principle_applied.reason: Budhikota test is correct, but the value omits the Bhajan Lal and abuse-of-process quashing principles the court applied.

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: Shambhoo Nath Misra; State of Haryana v. Bhajan Lal; Indian Oil Corpn. v. NEPC India; Inder Mohan Goswami; also Dr. Budhikota Subbarao (applied) and Naresh Kumar Madan (cited)
precedent_relied_upon.quote: Shambhoo Nath Misra v. State of U.P. (1997) 5 SCC 326 ... relied on
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Listed cases are correct, but Dr. Budhikota Subbarao, which the court applied, is omitted.

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentence was imposed, so no sentencing rationale applies.

other_sentence_order.quote: There shall however be no order as to costs.
other_sentence_order.reason: No other sentence or order besides no costs.
